execution.progress: The job survives disposable cursor interruption. Remaining inspection rounds, exact plot, exposure and paid effort are retained; explicit cancel/death settles the lock once.

details.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
details.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.
